rules.description: empireandallies: bypass cache for session and dynamic routes
rules.expression: (http.host eq "empireandallies.tsukimi.my") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/ruffle.html" "/login.html" "/register.html" "/logout" "/save-editor" "/language_editor" "/list_session" "/wipe_session" "/gazillionaire" "/deprogress"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/chat/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/friends/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/support/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/socket.io") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/seed/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/patch/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/unlock_quest/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/complete_quest/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/remove_quest/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/chooseavatar/") or http.request.uri.path contains "flashservices/gateway.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "record_stats.php")

rules.description: empireandallies: cache game assets, honour origin Cache-Control
rules.expression: (http.host eq "empireandallies.tsukimi.my") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/nullassets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/img/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/js/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/css/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/files/empire-s.assets.zgncdn.com/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/gameSettings.xml" "/en_US.xml" "/questSettings.xml" "/changelog.txt" "/favicon.ico"})
